provenance: manifest.json; reuse the existing pinned local release-20250330 inputs
selection_rule: Independent classes selected by source-level purpose and nontrivial state/control flow before any lowering evaluation; not selected by current success rate.

classes.name: OpenRA.Mods.Common.Traits.PlayerResources
classes.inventory: all members and recursively owned nested types
classes.behavior: Existing resource return/state/exception comparisons; other methods may explicitly fall back.

classes.name: OpenRA.Mods.Common.Traits.AmmoPool
classes.inventory: all members and recursively owned nested types
classes.behavior: Existing full-ammo/count return, state, identity and null checks; other methods may explicitly fall back.

classes.name: OpenRA.Support.MersenneTwister
classes.inventory: all members and recursively owned nested types
classes.behavior: All seven bodies and selected call dependencies must lower and pass the confirmed seed/state/sequence/range/float contract.

classes.name: OpenRA.Activities.Activity
classes.inventory: all members and recursively owned nested types, including abstract/virtual and iterator/generic metadata
classes.selection_reason: Real linked-activity state: walks a reference chain and appends a specific object. Not a getter or arithmetic-only toy.
classes.behavior: Queue on finite chains of lengths 0, 1, 3; append null or a distinct object; check every link and reference identity, preservation of existing nodes, and null receiver exception. Infinite/cyclic chains are inspected statically, not executed or timed out as proof.
known_needs: loop and array-free reference state mutation
classes.fallback_boundary: Other lifecycle, generic and iterator methods remain in inventory and may explicitly fall back; no comprehensive enum/generic/virtual/EH acceptance is implied.

classes.name: OpenRA.Mods.Common.Activities.Wait
classes.inventory: all members and recursively owned nested types; WaitFor is a sibling and must not be expanded
classes.selection_reason: Real countdown/cancellation state: early cancellation return plus old-value post-decrement and integer wraparound. Exercises metadata inheritance across the existing two input assemblies.
classes.behavior: Tick with null Actor (unused argument), canceling/noncanceling state and remainingTicks at int.MinValue, -1, 0, 1, 2, int.MaxValue; check return, remainingTicks after one and repeated calls, and null receiver exception. Preserve the actual base getter call; do not rewrite the selected Tick body from its source.
known_needs: precise direct MemberRef call to base getter
classes.fallback_boundary: Constructor metadata must be complete; unsupported constructor lowering may fall back. A known external getter may be exercised as an unchanged leaf or explicit single-operation test adapter, not substituted for the selected Wait.Tick body; no general dependency resolver is required.

limitations: Both independent classes are new to this implementation, but come from the same OpenRA release and share an activity abstraction. They are not random or broad ecosystem coverage.
Known needs describe future acceptance obligations, not current support or passed tests. If they require a large framework or unapproved semantic expansion, stop and ask rather than changing samples.
Only member identities and acceptance rules belong in tracked files. OpenRA source, raw metadata snapshots, IL and generated class output remain in ignored report/.
Inventory completeness and successful lowering are separate gates; neither decoding nor complete IL fallback counts as successful semantic decompilation.
